intent: To demonstrate the proportion of taxes owed by Americans that remained unpaid between 2008 and 2010.

units.meaning: The share of taxes owed that remained unpaid was 18.3%.
accepted_routes: 18.3% of taxes owed were not paid
Unpaid taxes made up 18.3% of the total owed
units.visual_evidence_rule: A NOT PAID slice/segment labeled 18.3% (or rounded 18%) must be visible and should appear as less than half of the whole.
units.temporal_anchor: the clause about taxes really owed; if narration adds an unpaid clause, it should carry this value.
units.reviewer_question: Must the video explicitly state the 18.3% unpaid share, or can it rely on the implied complement to the paid share?

optional_valid: Show a legend/color key for NOT PAID and TAXES PAID.
Round 81.7% to 82% and 18.3% to 18% for readability.
Animate the unpaid slice as the remainder after the paid slice.
Use a pie chart total of 100% of taxes owed.
unsupported_to_avoid: Dollar amounts of taxes owed or unpaid (not in the table).
Causal claims that IRS enforcement, policy, or economic conditions caused the unpaid share.
Extrapolating to years outside the clip or trends across years; the table has only one pie.
Saying unpaid was 18.3% of paid (wrong denominator; if derived, it is 18.3/81.7 ≈ 22.4% of paid).
Treating 18.3% and 81.7% as counts or dollar values rather than shares of taxes owed.
notes: Intent focuses on unpaid 18.3%; narration leads with paid 81.7%, so the paid complement is marked optional unless the reviewer requires full pie composition. The period context is in the intent/narration but not the table, so it is not used as a numeric basis unit.
file_naming: one G1 per input contract; B1/B3/B4/B5 need separate drafts
narration_use: reference only when drafting; required units must be derivable from the public B2 inputs (table + intent)
weight_mode_note: every unit gets 1/n so coverage is a plain share; weight_template is kept for per-type analysis only

trim.reason: required_candidate=false，非 intent 必须承担的命题
